goal: Plan-stability follow-up to the 2026-10-27 evening flapping incident (claim #4820, version 20261028013854 via merged-claim reissue of PR #4908, retirement 717757e7e7f17a94535ccfdfcb4f8f2e371961c1). Production EXPLAIN proved the mechanism: the meter's pending bucket nested-loops ~146k per-row heap probes into style_guide_files (thumbnail_url in no index), the waiting bucket plans a full seq scan of style_guide_files per call, and the claim's candidates CTE hash-joins 113k wide files heap rows against 146k wide document heap rows then fully sorts for the ordered LIMIT. Fix: two covering indexes with ZERO function-body changes (meter md5 0366a4d0bddee2c5a8b8f2d4ba73c69a and claim md5 1c6af615af8ecc225cbc57638bd4fd9c stay byte-identical, re-asserted by the migration's own guard and by foundation contract 13): idx_style_guide_files_thumbnail_live (id INCLUDE is_active WHERE thumbnail_url IS NOT NULL) makes every files-side liveness lookup index-only; idx_sg_search_documents_claim_pending (document_updated_at, style_guide_file_id INCLUDE thumbnail_url, embedding_next_retry_at, embedding_lease_expires_at, same predicate as meter_pending) covers the claim's ordered candidate walk so neither plan shape reads either heap, cold or warm. Contract 13 pins both new index definitions.
prohibited_actions: Do not change get_sg_search_embedding_status or claim_sg_search_embedding_documents semantics or bytes; both md5 pins must stand.
Do not add a second migration version to this pull request.
Do not modify any applied migration.
Do not bypass, weaken or retry around the exact-head review, the guarded merge, the preview rehearsal or the production promotion gates.
Do not rebase; merge main instead.
assumptions: The flapping is plan/IO-shape, not contention: production was quiet at both failure moments and all seven meter indexes were valid.
Non-concurrent CREATE INDEX inside the migration transaction is acceptable (brief ShareLock; readers unaffected; the backfill restarts absorb the write pause).
The meter's pending EXISTS and waiting NOT EXISTS semantics, including orphan left-join behavior, are untouched because the function bodies are untouched; only the plans change.
stop_conditions: Stop if either function body's md5 changes.
Stop if a governed review returns a substantive REJECT; fix on a new head and re-review.
Stop if any gate refuses; never work around it.
Stop if main advances past the version; supersede through the lane tool.
